fieldAllowlist: REQUIRED: exact GraphQL input field path

rollback.procedure: REQUIRED: exact compensating or restoration procedure that preserves identifiers and references.

partialFailureRecovery: Stop on GraphQL errors or userErrors, persist successful IDs and cursors, and resume only unresolved deterministic rows.
idempotency: Use stable owner/resource IDs plus compare-before-write semantics; rerunning an applied row must produce no additional change.

graphqlErrorHandling.transportErrors: Retry bounded transient failures and persist the resume cursor.
graphqlErrorHandling.graphqlErrors: Treat top-level GraphQL errors as a failed batch and write no success claim.
graphqlErrorHandling.userErrors: Record every field/message pair and never treat HTTP 200 as mutation success.

throttlingAndResume: Read throttleStatus, pause before exhaustion, persist deterministic row/cursor progress, and support bounded resume.
